Asset.name: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwasher
Asset.description: Built-in dishwasher covered by the service manual.

ErrorCode.name: E1
ErrorCode.description: Water inlet failure: the flow meter can't detect a correct fill after 4 minutes.

ErrorCode.name: E3
ErrorCode.description: Heater failure: the temperature doesn't reach the correct value after 90 minutes.

ErrorCode.name: E4
ErrorCode.description: Overflow: water flows into the base and activates the overflow switch.

ErrorCode.name: E6
ErrorCode.description: NTC open circuit failure: temperature sensor open circuit.

ErrorCode.name: E7
ErrorCode.description: NTC short circuit failure: temperature sensor short circuit.

Symptom.name: Won't run or power up (dead keypad/console)
Symptom.description: No operation, no keypad response, no LEDs or display.

Symptom.name: Will not fill or low water
Symptom.description: The dishwasher will not fill with water or fills with too little water.

Symptom.name: Wash pump will not pump
Symptom.description: The wash pump does not pump water during the cycle.

Symptom.name: Will not drain or excess water left in unit
Symptom.description: The dishwasher will not drain or excess water remains in the unit.

Symptom.name: Detergent not dispensing
Symptom.description: The detergent dispenser does not release detergent during the cycle.

FailureMode.name: Water inlet failure
FailureMode.description: During the water inlet step the flow meter can't detect a correct fill after 4 minutes.

FailureMode.name: Heater failure
FailureMode.description: The temperature doesn't reach the correct value after 90 minutes.

FailureMode.name: Overflow
FailureMode.description: Water flows into the base and activates the overflow switch.

FailureMode.name: No power to unit or bad connection
FailureMode.description: No power to the unit or a bad power connection.

FailureMode.name: Inlet screen on fill valve plugged
FailureMode.description: The inlet screen on the fill valve is plugged.

FailureMode.name: Faulty motor start capacitor
FailureMode.description: The wash pump motor start capacitor is faulty.

FailureMode.name: Drain pump impeller fractured
FailureMode.description: The drain pump impeller is fractured or stripped.

FailureMode.name: Obstructed drain hose or path
FailureMode.description: The drain hose or drain path is obstructed.

FailureMode.name: Mechanical binding of dispenser lid
FailureMode.description: The dispenser lid is mechanically binding.

FailureMode.name: Low water pressure or no water to dishwasher
FailureMode.description: Water pressure is low or no water reaches the dishwasher.

FailureMode.name: Excessive suds in pump
FailureMode.description: Excessive suds are present in the wash pump.

FailureMode.name: Diameter of drain hose too small
FailureMode.description: The installed drain hose diameter is too small.

FailureMode.name: Drain loop check valve not sealing and waste line plugged
FailureMode.description: The drain loop check valve does not seal while the disposer or waste line is plugged.

CorrectiveAction.name: Correct installation as necessary
CorrectiveAction.description: Restore an adequate water supply by correcting the installation.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Restore an adequate water supply by correcting the installation as necessary.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace control
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Check/replace control.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Repeatedly fill and cancel/drain to remove suds
CorrectiveAction.description: Repeatedly fill and drain the dishwasher until excessive suds are removed.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Repeatedly fill and cancel/drain to remove suds.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Install proper drain hose
CorrectiveAction.description: Install a drain hose with the proper diameter.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace entire drain loop
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the complete drain loop when the check valve leaks back.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If water flows into dishwasher, replace entire drain loop.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace the motor start capacitor if open
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the wash-pump motor start capacitor when it tests open.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Disconnect capacitor leads and confirm capacitance is as labeled on part or check resistance for open circuit across the terminals. Replace if open.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace the drain pump if the impeller is stripped
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace the drain pump when its impeller is stripped.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Remove drain pump and check impeller by pulling and rotating. If stripped - replace.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace the dispenser
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. Check/replace dispenser.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwashers Service Manual (W11187658)

Component.name: Water Inlet Valve
Component.description: Fill valve that admits water into the tub.

Component.name: Heater
Component.description: Recessed heating element for wash water and drying.

Component.name: Overflow Switch
Component.description: Switch in the base activated by overflow water.

Component.name: Power Supply Circuit
Component.description: Household supply, fuses, circuit breakers and junction box.

Component.name: Wash Pump Motor Capacitor
Component.description: Start capacitor of the wash pump motor.

Component.name: Drain Pump
Component.description: Pump that drains water from the sump.

Component.name: Drain Hose
Component.description: Hose and drain path from sump check valve to plumbing.

Component.name: Detergent Dispenser
Component.description: Detergent and rinse aid dispenser with lid and solenoid.

evidence.quote: during the water inlet step, if the flow meter can't detect a correct fill after 4 minutes, E1 will be displayed
Error code E1 ("QUICK" indicator flashes). Error: WATER INLET FAILURE.
Error code E3 ("QUICK" & "GLASS" indicators flash). Error: HEATER FAILURE.
Error code E4 ("LIGHT" indicator flashes). Error: OVERFLOW.
Error code E6 ("LIGHT" & "GLASS" indicators flash). Error: NTC OPEN CIRCUIT FAILURE.
Error code E7 ("LIGHT, GLASS & QUICK" indicators flash). Error: NTC SHORT CIRCUIT FAILURE.
Potential cause: low water pressure or no water to dishwasher.
Potential cause: faulty control.
Potential cause: excessive suds in pump due to using wrong or too much detergent or rinse aid.
Potential cause: diameter of drain hose too small.
Potential cause: drain loop check valve not sealing and customer disposer/waste line partially or fully plugged.
Potential cause: no power to unit or bad connection.
Verify water is turned on and supply line adequate. Correct installation as necessary.
Potential cause: inlet screen on fill valve plugged.
Potential cause: faulty control. Check: 1. Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. 2. Check/replace control.
Potential cause: faulty motor start capacitor.
Disconnect capacitor leads and confirm capacitance is as labeled on part or check resistance for open circuit across the terminals. Replace if open.
Potential cause: drain pump impeller fractured.
Remove drain pump and check impeller by pulling and rotating. If stripped - replace.
Potential cause: obstructed drain hose or path.
Repeatedly fill and cancel/drain to remove suds.
Potential cause: diameter of drain hose too small. Check: check/install proper drain hose.
If water flows into dishwasher, replace entire drain loop.
Potential cause: mechanical binding of dispenser lid.
Check: 1. Unplug dishwasher or disconnect power. 2. Check/replace dispenser.
